forked/child processes and complete thread coverage are not established

host return does not establish GPU completion or materialization readiness
provider buffers have no collector-enforced hard memory budget
native observation can change reference lifetimes, allocation and timing
conditions: caller bound this retained directory to its explicit lossless archive manifest
fixed collector writes its declared artifacts and manifests without external tampering
retained strace files belong to the supplied single capture; missing process actors remain OPEN
Kineto CPU host-thread lookup explicitly uses Linux native TID; GPU lanes are a different namespace
